mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name AS courseName, u.real_name AS teacherName, c.semester, IF(ce.course_id IS NOT NULL, 1, 0) AS isEvaluated, IF(ce.course_id IS NULL AND ss.course_id IS NOT NULL, 1, 0) AS canEvaluate FROM selection_record sr INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = sr.course_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.teacher_id LEFT JOIN course_evaluation ce ON ce.course_id = c.id AND ce.student_id = sr.student_id LEFT JOIN student_score ss ON ss.course_id = c.id AND ss.student_id = sr.student_id AND ss.score IS NOT NULL AND ss.status = 1 WHERE sr.student_id = #{studentId} AND sr.status = 1 AND c.status = 1

SELECT u.id AS teacherId, u.real_name AS teacherName, oc.name AS collegeName, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS courseCount, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.id) AS evaluationCount, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(ce.score), 2), 0) AS avgScore, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(ce.teaching_ability), 2), 0) AS teachingAbility, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(ce.class_atmosphere), 2), 0) AS classAtmosphere, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(ce.knowledge_clarity), 2), 0) AS knowledgeClarity, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(ce.homework_feedback), 2), 0) AS homeworkFeedback, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(ce.qa_service), 2), 0) AS qaService FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN course c ON c.teacher_id = u.id AND c.status = 1 LEFT JOIN org_college oc ON u.college_id = oc.id LEFT JOIN course_evaluation ce ON ce.course_id = c.id WHERE u.role = 'teacher' AND u.status = 1
AND u.college_id = #{collegeId}
AND c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{subject}, '%')
GROUP BY u.id, u.real_name, oc.name ORDER BY avgScore DESC, evaluationCount DESC
